s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral visual disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Blurry vision in one eye for several months
Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid in the affected eye
Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber
key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
On anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders
Unremarkable computed tomography of the chest

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic unilateral visual disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Blurry vision in one eye for several months
Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid in the affected eye
Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber
key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
On anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders
Unremarkable computed tomography of the chest

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of blurry vision, cystoid macular edema with a yellow spot in the fovea, and significant cystoid macular edema and subfoveal fluid on OCT scans, along with leakage on fluorescein angiography, strongly supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: uveitis
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of bilateral iritis, which is a form of uveitis, the current presentation is more specifically explained by cystoid macular edema.

rejected.label: anterior uveitis
rejected.why: The patient's history of bilateral iritis suggests anterior uveitis, but the current symptoms and findings are more consistent with cystoid macular edema.

rejected.label: macular edema
rejected.why: This is a broader term that encompasses cystoid macular edema, but cystoid macular edema is a more specific diagnosis that matches the patient's presentation.

rejected.label: ocular sporotrichosis
rejected.why: There is no evidence in the patient's history or test results to support this rare fungal infection as the cause of her symptoms.
